author: Jason Kim

steps.title: Perform Survival Surgery
steps.instruction: Establish a chronic indwelling catheter for intravenous infusion 5~6 days prior to the experiment.

substeps.instruction: Refer to M1023: Surgery-jugular vein cannulation

steps.title: Fast Mice
steps.instruction: Fast mice either overnight (~15 hours) or for 5 hours prior to the start of the experiment.

steps.title: Prepare Mouse for Infusion
steps.instruction: Secure the mouse and prepare the catheter for pump connection.

substeps.instruction: Place the mouse in a rat-size restrainer with its tail tape-tethered at one end
Expose and flush the intravenous catheter using saline solution
Connect the catheter to the CMA Microdialysis infusion pump

steps.title: Collect Basal Plasma Sample
steps.instruction: Collect a 10 µl plasma sample before the start of the experiment (basal-0 min) to measure basal glucose levels.

steps.title: Administer Palmitate Bolus
steps.instruction: Start the experiment by administering a bolus intravenous injection of 20 µCi of [1- 14 C] palmitate.

steps.title: Collect Post-Injection Plasma Samples
steps.instruction: Rapidly collect 10 µl plasma samples at specific intervals after injection to measure systemic [1- 14 C] palmitate concentrations.

substeps.instruction: Collect samples at 0.5, 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 min after injection

steps.title: Euthanize and Collect Tissues
steps.instruction: Euthanize the mice at the end of the experiment and collect tissues for further studies if necessary.
